current_stage.name: Homepage-first DS2 hierarchy pass after live selected-tour proof
current_stage.last_material_progress: PR #677 extended the existing single-search production visual gate through the actual choose-tour -> populated selected-tour -> return-to-results journey at 1440/1024/768. The gate passed against current production with 10 populated facts, contained picture/flights/lead surfaces, correct selected-price responsive hierarchy, 54px lead CTA height, no horizontal overflow and valid return to preserved results. Runtime CSS/JS, Tourvisor, analytics/Metrika, pricing and lead transport were unchanged.
current_stage.next_action: Selected-tour handoff is production-stable at 768/1024/1440. Continue the weakest public-route DS2 slice from homepage hierarchy/discovery flow using existing 375/430/768/1024/1440 evidence. Fix only confirmed hierarchy/spacing/wrapping/shared-shell defects in canonical owners, then move to /hot/, /contacts/, /how-to-buy/ and /rb/ as evidence warrants.

local_results_filtering.rule: Result filters such as stars/rating/price/meal and other fields already present in normalized loaded results filter the loaded set instantly. A new Tourvisor search is reserved for real search-input changes or optional background capability expansion, not for every result-filter click.

site_wide_score.note: The real results -> selected-tour -> return journey is now directly proven on production at tablet/desktop breakpoints, but this slice changed CI/evidence rather than visible product design, so the whole-product score remains unchanged.
